description: Ports Propres en Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. Le dispositif « Ports Propres en Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur » a pour objectif l’amélioration de la gestion environnementale des ports de plaisance et de pêche. Ces équipements visent essentiellement à traiter les effluents et eaux usées des navires, collecter et traiter les déchets solides et lutter contre les pollutions accidentelles. Coverage: Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. The portal shows the English title as "Clean ports in Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. Its keywords include environnement, plaisance, monlittoral, ecologie, dechet, port. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
